title: Read a list
summary: Kotlin: Read a list. Read the first item.
introduction: listOf makes a read-only list. The first item has index zero.

blocks.text: Install a JDK and Kotlin. Save lesson.kt, run kotlinc lesson.kt -include-runtime -d lesson.jar, then java -jar lesson.jar.

blocks.title: Read a list

blocks.text: listOf stores cat at zero and dog at one. Index 1 reads dog.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use a mutable list when you need add or remove operations.
